title: rtemis
tagline: Decentralised gig economy for people to list or purchase jobs and services
description: App that allows users to use wallets like Metamask to post gig economy listings for job or services that need to be fulfilling. On the other side, users can answer listings and if they are fulfilled, then payments are sent to the fulfiller. Integrates with various authentication providers to help participants understand each other's reputation.
how_its_made: This project uses NextJS, ReactJS, ethers, RainbowKit, wagmi, IPFS, XMTP, and will be deployed to many EVM compatible chains, as time permits. Since it will be fully on-chain besides the convenience browsing UI, we may be able to leverage querying technologies like Covalent and Tableland.
